children: Steven E. Karol, a Director, reported a sale of Carpenter Technology common stock on September 4, 2026. The shares were sold at an average price of $474.0817 per share, with individual trades ranging from $474.00 to $474.17. The total sale amount reported was $1,552,617 for 3,275 shares disposed. Following the transaction, Karol directly owned 177,000 shares and indirectly owned 223,381 shares held by affiliates.
